Civil design study / illustration

From site question
to site solution.

I work across the civil infrastructure lifecycle: understanding a site, testing options, coordinating a design, working through approvals, and supporting construction and close-out.

The work connects clients, councils, asset owners, contractors and other disciplines. Clear information and practical judgement matter at every handover.

What I bring to a project

Land & access

Site assessment, earthworks and grading, building platforms, road geometry, vehicle access and coordination with retaining and boundary constraints.

12d Model / CAD

Three waters

Stormwater management, overland-flow planning, wastewater and water supply, with attention to levels, network interfaces and maintenance access.

Analysis / Coordination

Approvals & delivery

Engineering-plan coordination, council responses, contract and procurement support, construction review, as-builts and certification support.

Design / Construction

A clear path through
complex decisions.

Good outcomes start with the right questions and continue through careful follow-through.

  1. 01

    Read the site

    Check survey, levels, services, field evidence and the decision the project needs.

  2. 02

    Join the disciplines

    Coordinate landform, access, drainage, utilities and construction constraints.

  3. 03

    Test the thinking

    Compare options, challenge assumptions and make the review trail clear.

  4. 04

    Follow through

    Support delivery, resolve queries and carry lessons into the next design.
